pages.lesson:
LESSON: MIRACLES OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Miracles of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Miracles of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how they prayed for a sick person. How did the Roman officer demonstrate faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant
   In simple words: practise until you can discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Miracles of Jesus Christ using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Miracles of Jesus Christ in the examples.
2. Explain Miracles of Jesus Christ to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Miracles of Jesus Christ.
4. Show that you can: discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Miracles of Jesus Christ using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Miracles of Jesus Christ important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Matthew 8:5-13 and narrate the miracle,
2. List lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant,
3. Role play the healing of the Roman officer’s servant,
4. Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced as learners role-play the miracle of healing the Roman Officer’s servant.
5. Learning to learn: the skill of developing relationships is enhanced as learners share what they learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant. 22 Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the Roman officer’s servant

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
